paragraphs: Baseline provides engineered irrigation solutions built on proprietary two-wire technology and real-time sensor data. The premise is that a sensor-based control system responds dynamically to real-time data, using algorithms to make better irrigation decisions.

Controller platforms listed on the site include BaseStation 3200S, BaseStation 1000, AG 1000, SubStation and FlowStation. Sensors cover soil moisture, precipitation, flow and pressure. The software carries the names AppManager, BaseManager, BACnet Manager and PipeView Analytics. The device catalog runs from two-wire and conventional-wire devices to control point technology, solar and DC power, and the WaterTec S100.

The site sorts customers into groups that include cities and municipalities. Colleges and universities form another named group. Project highlights describe how Longwood Cricket Club uses Baseline products to manage its tennis court complex. Another highlight covers Baseline at the 9/11 Memorial. The company says it works with clients to discover desired objectives, develop the design intent and deliver successful outcomes.

quote.text: A sensor-based control system is able to dynamically respond to real-time data using algorithms to make better irrigation decisions.
